text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. And so, the rescue scene ends in
failure!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! Ah, yes, I knew it. I knew it
all
along!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A theatrical twist! You desired to
compose a
tragedy!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You've flown too close to the sun that is
I and,
thus, have lost your wings! A
brilliant metaphor!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas, you poor souls behind this glass!
Forgive my
corruptible radiance!
